_readme: Edit this file to configure Baxter. Every setting is optional. See the README.
_local_override_note: This file (preferences.json) is the global, public config — the defaults every clone gets, safe to commit and publish. If preferences.local.json exists, it is read INSTEAD of this file, in full, so a user's real live settings never leak into a published fork. It is gitignored and never published — create it only if you want your own real settings (including integrations, e.g. your own GitHub repo or tracker workspace) without publishing them. Keep its keys identical to this file's; only the values should differ.
